Q: In snowflake, is it a good common pattern to define clustering key as the descending timestamp of when each row was inserted? A:

Do you have any reference for the claim that natural order versus reverse natural order makes no difference? If snowflake automatically clusters by natural ingestion order and what you say about asc vs. desc not mattering is correct, then adding a clustering key would in theory offer no improvement because the sorting I want is desc on a column which is always the CURRENT_TIMESTAMP default value.

Q: Spring Boot configuration is missing from Run/Debug Configuration A:

For my situation, Spring Boot is bundled w my IntelliJ Ultimate subscription and not available otherwise. Once I reactivated/renewed my subscription (through my company) Spring Boot returned as an option under Add Run/Debug Configurations
